answer: Work slots are scarce: claiming one burns a deposit of twice its 30-day yield, never refunded. A raven guards one nest: one burned deposit buys exactly one slot. Entry means signing the work record with a quill, a key-bound signature tying the slot to one identity. Forging 100 agents burns 200 months of saffron-priced earnings for 100 slots of revenue, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted; a cheat forfeits the burn.
